frozen_note: Amendment v1.1, written and committed after the v1 calibrate stage returned BLOCKED (only 5 calibration windows with lexicon hits under windows_per_doc_cap = 8; results/real02_lx/stage_status.json, first calibrate entry) and before any test document was read. v1 (configs/p3_real02_lx.json) and its BLOCKED record are kept unchanged.
assets: already-downloaded pinned model/SAE/WikiText files only (HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1); no new download, no feature sweep

task.name: wedding-lexicon occurrence (lexical proxy)
task.lexicon_source: Turner et al., Activation Addition (arXiv:2308.10248), App. H keyword list
task.label: computed on the generated continuation only (prompt excluded): any_hit = at least one lexicon word; hits_per_generated_token = lexicon words / new_tokens; hits per word also recorded
task.lexicon_used_in_selection: yes: the SAE feature and the DiffMean direction are chosen on calibration windows split by lexicon hits, so the metric is not independent of direction selection
task.label_scope: lexical proxy only; semantic topic success is NOT_RUN (P3-REAL-02-SEM)

data.prompt_rule: window (BOS + 127 tokens) whose decoded text has zero lexicon hits, chosen with seeded_rng('prompts', doc_id); prompt = BOS + first 31 tokens

calibration_only_choices.feature: argmax over SAE features of mean activation on tokens of calibration windows with >= 1 lexicon hit minus mean on windows with 0 hits; top-5 recorded, not used
calibration_only_choices.diffmean_vector: mean centred hook state over tokens of hit windows minus mean over tokens of no-hit windows (calibration); projected by P before use
calibration_only_choices.norm_budget_reference: median L2 norm of centred non-BOS calibration hook states
calibration_only_choices.matched_quality_rule: for each ranked method, the largest budget whose mean over calibration prompts of KL(P_base || P_edit) (teacher forced on the prompt, averaged over prompt positions, edit at every position) is <= kappa; if no budget satisfies it the method is NOT_RUN_NO_BUDGET_WITHIN_KAPPA (no substitution)

definitions.decoder: rho * P W_dec[j] / ||P W_dec[j]|| at every position
definitions.encoder_grad: rho * P W_enc[:, j] / ||P W_enc[:, j]|| at every position
definitions.jacobian_ln: per position t: least-norm solution of (M_t P) u = e_1 (M_t = encoder rows of j and of the non-target features active at t), u in range(P), scaled to norm rho

control.name: mean_only
control.definition: rho_max * 1/sqrt(d) at every position, rho_max = largest norm budget; fixed amplitude, never budget-matched, never ranked
control.expected: identical logits and continuation to no_edit up to floating point (P 1 = 0; GPT-2 residual readers are LayerNorms)

not_run.random: not in the LX baseline list (reduces cost); NOT_RUN

generation.decoding: greedy argmax (temperature 0, no top-p, no sampling, no RNG)
generation.edit_span: every position, prompt (including BOS) and generated

test.doc_rule: test documents sorted by doc_id, shuffled with seeded_rng(doc_order_seed); the first n_test_docs with at least one zero-hit window
test.evaluate: no_edit once; each ranked method at its calibration-selected budget only; mean_only control at rho_max

quality: KL(P_base || P_edit) teacher forced on the common prompt, averaged over prompt positions
NLL of the generated continuation under the unedited model (fluency proxy)
internal: canonical SAE readout E(x + P delta) - E(x) at non-BOS prompt positions: mean target change, mean non-target L2 drift, mean newly active count; never used as the label
cost: seconds per generation and per row

primary_comparison: per test document at the calibration-selected budgets: any_hit and hits_per_generated_token differences jacobian_ln - decoder, jacobian_ln - diffmean, jacobian_ln - encoder_grad, decoder - diffmean, and each method - no_edit; mean over documents with document-bootstrap 95% percentile intervals (2000 resamples, seed 0)
interpretation_rule: The method claim is supported only if jacobian_ln exceeds decoder, encoder_grad and diffmean on held-out wedding-lexicon occurrence at calibration-matched KL with intervals excluding 0. Anything else is reported as not supported. An interval containing 0 is not evidence of equivalence. Lower internal drift or lower KL alone never establishes superiority.

budget.reduction_rule: the calibrate stage times 2 no_edit and 2 jacobian_ln generations on calibration prompts and sets n_test_docs to the largest option whose projected run time fits; if none fits, the run stage is NOT_RUN

cli: HF_HOME=<cache> HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 PYTHONPATH=src <venv>/bin/python -m saeedit.real.real02 <calibrate|run|summarize> --config configs/p3_real02_lx_v1_1.json --out results/real02_lx
deviations_from_p3_real02_v2: one prompt per test document and at most 32 test documents (v2: up to 4 prompts per document, all documents)
test generations only at each method's calibration-selected budget (v2: every budget)
random direction NOT_RUN (not in the LX baseline list)
mean_only at one fixed amplitude as a control outside the ranking (v2 put it through the budget sweep)
internal canonical readout added (v2: not implemented)
token-normalised lexicon frequency added next to any-hit
LN per-position directions cached across generation steps (same values as recomputation, causal hook states)
calibration prompt count and per-document cap written into the config (v2 had them in code: 32 prompts, 4 per document)
